import urandom as random

SIREN_MS = 600                 # mistake: broken siren falling from 1000 to 200 Hz

simon_timer = None
simon_siren_timer = None
simon_wait = 0
simon_sequence = []
simon_colors = [0x16834B, 0xB52F3B, 0xC69214, 0x245DB5]
simon_bright = [0x35E887, 0xFF6070, 0xFFE052, 0x58A6FF]
simon_notes = [415, 310, 252, 209]
simon_buttons = []


def screen_size():
    display = lv.display_get_default()
    return display.get_horizontal_resolution(), display.get_vertical_resolution()


def simon_layout():
    # Fits any screen: the unit is 1/240 of the short side.
    width, height = screen_size()
    unit = min(width, height) / 240
    small = width < 400
    margin, bar, gap = int(6 * unit), int(26 * unit), int(6 * unit)
    ui.background.set_size(width, height)
    button = width // 2 + margin if width < 600 else width * 3 // 10
    ui.start.set_pos(width - margin - button, margin)
    ui.start.set_size(button, bar)
    ui.title.set_pos(margin, margin)
    ui.title.set_size(width - button - 3 * margin, bar)
    top = margin + bar + gap // 2
    status = int(34 * unit) if width < 600 else int(18 * unit)  # two lines on narrow screens
    ui.status.set_pos(margin, top)
    ui.status.set_size(width - 2 * margin, status)
    if small:
        ui.status.set_style_text_font(lv.font_montserrat_14, lv.PART.MAIN)
    top += status + gap // 2
    pad_w, pad_h = (width - 2 * margin - gap) // 2, (height - top - margin - gap) // 2
    for index, pad in enumerate(simon_buttons):
        pad.set_pos(margin + index % 2 * (pad_w + gap), top + index // 2 * (pad_h + gap))
        pad.set_size(pad_w, pad_h)
        if small:
            pad.get_child(0).set_style_text_font(lv.font_montserrat_16, lv.PART.MAIN)


def simon_light(index, bright=True):
    colors = simon_bright if bright else simon_colors
    simon_buttons[index].set_style_bg_color(lv.color_hex(colors[index]), lv.PART.MAIN)
    if bright:
        ui.buzzer1.beep(simon_notes[index], 420)


def simon_siren(timer):
    global simon_wait, simon_siren_timer
    simon_wait = max(0, simon_wait - 20)
    if simon_wait and (simon_wait // 60) % 2:
        ui.buzzer1.tone(200 + 800 * simon_wait // SIREN_MS)
    else:
        ui.buzzer1.off()
    if not simon_wait:
        timer.delete()
        simon_siren_timer = None


def simon_reset():
    global simon_timer, simon_sequence, simon_playing, simon_playback
    global simon_show_index, simon_user_index, simon_buttons, simon_siren_timer
    simon_buttons = [ui.green, ui.red, ui.yellow, ui.blue]
    if simon_timer is not None:
        simon_timer.delete()
        simon_timer = None
    if simon_siren_timer is not None:
        ui.buzzer1.off()
        simon_siren_timer.delete()
        simon_siren_timer = None
    simon_sequence = []
    simon_playing = False
    simon_playback = False
    simon_show_index = 0
    simon_user_index = 0
    for index in range(4):
        simon_light(index, False)
    ui.status.set_text("Press START and repeat the sequence")


def simon_tick(_timer):
    global simon_show_index, simon_playback, simon_user_index
    if not simon_playing or not simon_playback:
        return
    if simon_show_index < len(simon_sequence):
        for index in range(4):
            simon_light(index, False)
        simon_light(simon_sequence[simon_show_index])
        simon_show_index += 1
    else:
        for index in range(4):
            simon_light(index, False)
        simon_playback = False
        simon_user_index = 0
        ui.status.set_text("Your turn: repeat " + str(len(simon_sequence)) + " colors")


def simon_start():
    global simon_timer, simon_playing, simon_playback, simon_show_index
    simon_reset()
    simon_sequence.append(random.getrandbits(2))
    simon_playing = True
    simon_playback = True
    simon_show_index = 0
    ui.status.set_text("Watch the sequence...")
    simon_timer = lv.timer_create(simon_tick, 550, None)


def simon_press(index):
    global simon_playback, simon_playing, simon_show_index, simon_user_index
    global simon_timer, simon_siren_timer, simon_wait
    if not simon_playing or simon_playback:
        return
    for pad in range(4):
        simon_light(pad, False)
    if index != simon_sequence[simon_user_index]:
        simon_playing = False
        simon_timer.delete()
        simon_timer = None
        simon_wait = SIREN_MS
        simon_siren_timer = lv.timer_create(simon_siren, 20, None)
        ui.status.set_text("Wrong sequence! Score: " + str(len(simon_sequence) - 1))
        return
    simon_light(index)
    simon_user_index += 1
    if simon_user_index == len(simon_sequence):
        if len(simon_sequence) == 8:
            simon_playing = False
            simon_timer.delete()
            simon_timer = None
            ui.status.set_text("You win! 8 sequences completed")
            return
        simon_sequence.append(random.getrandbits(2))
        simon_playback = True
        simon_show_index = 0
        ui.status.set_text("Well done! Watch the next round...")
